Problem Statement:
Given n non-negative integers representing an elevation map where the width of each bar is 1, compute how much water it is able to trap after raining using Stack. Black indicates bricks. Blue indicates water after raining.

The above elevation map is represented by array [0,1,0,2,1,0,1,3,2,1,2,1]. In this case, 6 units of rain water (blue section) are being trapped.
input_spec: First line represents the size of an elevation map. Next line contains units of bricks.
output_spec: Print the total water it is able to trap after raining.
